correctness.rationale: The exact sum/difference factorization excludes all other real prime-two solutions. The derivative has determinant b at every point, and the return trace reduces algebraically to -2*a^2+9*(1+b)^2-2*b for the two non-antipodal cycles. The strictly dissipative Jury inequalities give exactly the stated open sink window, neutral multipliers (-1,-b^2), and saddle classification. The antiphase trace lies above 1+b^2. Exact b=1/5 specialization is 34/5; finite checks support but do not replace the proof.
